title: Awesome Jev developer tool directory
scope: Reviewed documentation for distinct projects. Purposes can overlap; inclusion does not imply execution or independent reproduction.

tools.title: TypeSafe Python SDK
tools.en: The official sync and async client for typed Jev questions and answers.
tools.zh: 官方 Python 同步与异步客户端，支持类型化问题和答案。

tools.title: TypeSafe JavaScript SDK
tools.en: The official JavaScript client with answer types inferred from your questions.
tools.zh: 官方 JavaScript 客户端，可根据问题推导答案类型。

tools.title: TypeSafe Agent Skills
tools.en: Official guidance for coding agents building with the System One API.
tools.zh: 帮助编码 agent 使用 System One API 的官方技能。

tools.title: TypeSafe Public Examples
tools.en: Source code accompanying official documentation, demos, and cookbooks.
tools.zh: 官方文档、演示与实践教程配套源代码。

tools.title: protoc-gen-jev
tools.en: Generates typed Go, TypeScript and Python clients from annotated Protobuf schemas. Generator and runtime releases must be matched; backend behavior was not tested here.
tools.zh: 从带注释的 Protobuf 定义生成 Go、TypeScript 和 Python 类型化客户端；生成器与运行库需匹配版本，本项目未测试后端行为。

tools.title: TypeSafe for n8n
tools.en: TypeSafe-maintained nodes for adding typed decisions to n8n workflows.
tools.zh: 由 TypeSafe 维护的 n8n 节点，用于将类型化决策加入工作流。

tools.title: Abide
tools.en: Jev checks edits and turns against compiled project rules and requests repairs; missing credentials or network let edits pass unchecked, and replay findings depend on the chosen rubric.
tools.zh: 用 Jev 按编译后的项目规则检查编辑和轮次，并请求修复；缺少凭据或网络时会放行未检查编辑，回放结果也取决于规则设计。

tools.title: jev-fabric
tools.en: Native process orchestration with bounded logs, deadlines and explicit typed decisions; commands run with caller privileges, exit status needs outcome checks, and selected policy proofs do not verify the whole runtime.
tools.zh: 原生进程编排，提供有界日志、截止时间与显式类型化决策；命令使用调用者权限，退出状态仍需结果核验，部分策略证明不等于整个运行时已验证。

tools.title: atoma
tools.en: Multi-agent planning, execution and evidence review with Jev routing; shared agent/skill learning can expose document-derived material across organizations, and tenant isolation is not independently audited.
tools.zh: 结合 Jev 路由的多 agent 规划、执行与证据审查；共享 agent／技能学习可能使文档衍生内容跨组织可读，租户隔离尚未经过独立审计。

tools.title: JevLang
tools.en: TypeScript/Python policy layer separates typed model answers from routing and action dispatch, with documented journals and replay; a trace does not establish truthful inputs or calibrated thresholds.
tools.zh: TypeScript／Python 策略层将类型化模型答案与路由、动作分发分开，提供日志与重放说明；可追溯记录不证明输入真实或阈值已校准。

tools.title: cua-s1.js
tools.en: Browser ports of Cua form and next-action models; output-parity checks do not establish generalization, and the small form model can confidently skip unfamiliar fields.
tools.zh: Cua 表单与下一步动作模型的浏览器移植；输出一致性检查不证明泛化，小型表单模型可能高置信度跳过陌生字段。

tools.title: jev-omni.js
tools.en: Work-in-progress WebGPU port for Jev-Omni text and image decisions; audio/video are unfinished, model downloads are large, and reported parity is limited to selected fixtures and hardware.
tools.zh: 开发中的 Jev-Omni 文本与图像决策 WebGPU 移植；音视频未完成、模型下载体积较大，一致性结果仅覆盖指定样本与硬件。

tools.title: mJev
tools.en: Shared-context candidate scoring with HF/vLLM routes; normalized option probabilities are not calibrated confidence, and the reported cache speedup trades higher memory in one controlled video setup.
tools.zh: 通过 HF/vLLM 路径进行共享上下文候选评分；选项归一化概率不是已校准置信度，所报缓存加速在一个受控视频设置中需要更多显存。

tools.title: FRIDA-Decisions
tools.en: Packed Russian–English encoder runtime for typed questions and ranking; state truncation, Russian instruction suffixes and margin-versus-probability semantics remain explicit.
tools.zh: 面向类型化问题与排序的俄英双语编码器运行库；需注意状态截断、俄语指令后缀，以及边际分数与归一化概率的区别。

tools.title: Quyet runtime
tools.en: Runtime for Quyet decision models with checkpoint-dependent English/Vietnamese coverage; it documents ten-option limits and state truncation, without evaluated adversarial robustness.
tools.zh: Quyet 决策模型运行库，英越语言覆盖依检查点而异；文档说明最多十个选项及状态截断，尚未确立对抗鲁棒性。

tools.title: System One Adapter
tools.en: Compare LLMs through the same question interface, with probability outputs and request diagnostics.
tools.zh: 用相同问题接口比较 LLM，支持概率输出与请求诊断。

tools.title: circuit
tools.en: LoRA and pointer-head training, evaluation and serving for text, image and audio decisions; publisher tests cover selected task sets and do not establish universal calibration or option-order invariance.
tools.zh: 面向文本、图像与音频决策的 LoRA、指针头训练、评测和服务工具；发布者测试只覆盖选定任务集，不能证明普遍校准或选项顺序不变性。

tools.title: SearchJev training pipeline
tools.en: Search-agent decision training with soft-label and Brier losses, reliability weights and per-question-type temperature fitting; the documented pipeline and split controls were not reproduced.
tools.zh: 面向搜索 agent 决策的训练流程，包含软标签与 Brier 损失、可靠性权重及按问题类型拟合温度；文档中的流程与切分控制尚未复现。

tools.title: OpenThai-SystemOne
tools.en: Thai/English text decision-model training and serving pipeline with a slot readout; the documented recipe does not establish independently validated calibration or interface equivalence.
tools.zh: 采用槽位读出的泰英文本决策模型训练与服务流程；文档中的配方不代表校准或接口等价性已获独立验证。

tools.title: sysone decision-learning library
tools.en: Training, calibration and interpretation tools for several text, image and protein backends; documented compatibility checks and small experiments do not validate every backend or workload.
tools.zh: 提供多种文本、图像及蛋白质后端的训练、校准和解释工具；文档中的兼容检查与小实验不代表所有后端和任务已获验证。
